use_local_when: target is the local anchor, or a directed non-distractor local-anchor-to-target edge has strength >=0.60
fallback: Preserve default Miere anchor for missing local concept, weak edge, reversed-only edge, distractor, indirect path or unrelated target.
scope: Contexto accepted guesses and secret-aware suggestions use the same private anchor helper. No exact alias, new surface, KG, pack, target promotion or other game change.
